question: What destructive power is attributed to the practitioner when angered?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry.
The practitioner has the power to destroy.
The scope of destruction includes the entire triple world, moving and unmoving.
inference: When angered, the practitioner can destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
